selectionHint: Choose a record to see its position and Street View, or go back to the start and end of the trip.
chronological: Records are sorted by time (UTC). Records with the same time keep the order in which they were received. The original times are shown unchanged.
sourceOrder: Records are shown in the order in which they were received, because not every record has a confirmed UTC time. Breaks between records are not checked.
recordPolicy: Each row is a separate record with its own source and ID. Records at the same place or time stay as separate rows. Duplicate records are removed when the data is loaded.
unavailableHint: The GPS records have not been loaded. The start and end of the trip are still available.
emptyHint: Loading finished, but no GPS records were found. This does not prove that the vehicle did not move.
missingSelection: The selected record is not among the loaded records. Choose another row or go back to the start and end of the trip.
thresholdBefore: This list shows breaks longer than
thresholdAfter: minutes between records that have coordinates and a confirmed UTC time.
intervalHint: This limit is a display setting in holita for the loaded records, not how often the device sends data. A long break does not prove that part of the trip is missing, and finding none does not prove that the whole trip was recorded.
intervalsUnassessed: Breaks can be checked only when at least two records have coordinates and every loaded record has a confirmed UTC time.
noLongIntervals: No breaks longer than this were found between the loaded records with coordinates.
declaredHint: The data source reports these gaps. They are separate from the long-break limit in holita and are not calculated from this list.
noDeclaredGaps: The source reports no gaps. This does not prove that the data has no gaps.
